item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia and Ukraine concluded a major prisoner swap during U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi, but the negotiations ended without a broader peace breakthrough. Ukraine struck Russia's largest oil refinery 2,500 km away with drones, while Russia hit Ukraine's power grid and conducted drone attacks on the Ust-Luga port and occupied Donetsk Airport. Russia also reported intercepting 146 drones in the Leningrad region and a drone that wounded three energy workers in Sumy Oblast. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Israeli detention has seen the health of Gaza doctor Abu Safia deteriorate, and Prime Minister Netanyahu denied Israeli responsibility for camp conditions. Turkey’s president labeled the Gaza war an ecocide at a UN climate summit, and France turned back settler leader Yossi Dagan on entry to Paris. Lewis Hamilton urged Israel to open the Rafah border for aid. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Former Iraqi MP Ahmed al-Alwani was killed in Beirut, prompting further updates. France opened a probe into alleged Israeli war crimes and protests against Israeli attacks occurred in Sweden. Republicans blocked an effort to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth over the Iran war, and a separate impeachment motion was blocked with several Democrats absent. item.description:

Seed insecurity is threatening Tigray farmers and a psychosocial and spiritual care pilot is being tested.
